name: Onatan! ~Bishoujo Tantei Monogatari~
original_name: オナたん！～美少女探偵物語～
source:
Onatan! is a high school detective eroge from Tower of Desire
with artwork by Penta Aogiri, voiced by Kanari Kanzaki.
The game is a multi-scene story about an upstanding girl detective
who sexually dominates her boy partner, George.
-from DLsite
translation:
奥纳坦！是《欲望之塔》中的高中生侦探《工口游戏》由青桐五角 (Penta Aogiri) 创作，神崎金成 (Kanari Kanzaki) 配音。
该游戏是一个关于正直女侦探的多场景故事
她在性上支配着她的男友乔治。
-来自DLsite
